Explanation: Provenance is the origin or earliest history of data; includes ownership records and transformation history.
PROV specifications define ontology and data model standards for expressing provenance across systems.
Provenance spans genealogy, phylogeny, art authentication, and scientific research such as climatology.
Tools like YW allow annotation of code to make implicit workflows explicit; NW captures Python execution.
Scripts in R or Python often perform complex workflows; provenance is needed but not embedded by default.
YW enables visual modeling of workflows from script comments without modifying the script logic.
NW records provenance automatically from Python code execution and supports filtered lineage analysis.
Use cases include gene expression analysis, paleoclimate reconstruction, and X-ray diffraction pipelines.
DataONE infrastructure captures and utilizes provenance metadata to ensure reproducibility and discovery.
